Guides

Create, edit & delete profiles

Choose a wallpaper, customize a draft, then decide whether to use it. No internal files to edit.

Create without TOML#

Terminal
ghostty-wall create
ghostty-wall create night

Supply an id to skip that prompt, or choose one interactively. IDs are lowercase; an existing id is an error, never an overwrite. Choose Generate for a stable gradient wallpaper, or Image for your PNG/JPEG. The picker starts at system Downloads/Pictures, including localized folders, and supports navigation, search and decode validation.

The original image is copied, never moved or modified. Another variant regenerates only an unsaved generated draft. Save publishes a complete Profile; Use now activates it, while Not now leaves the terminal unchanged. Cancel before Save leaves no partial Profile.

Edit a visual draft#

Terminal
ghostty-wall edit night
ghostty-wall edit

Missing id opens a selector; a named missing Profile is an error. Tab switches Wallpaper, Colors and Terminal. Arrows adjust choices/numbers; Enter opens exact numeric entry or a color picker. In the picker, h accepts exact hex and a resets a color to Automatic. Replace image reuses the creation picker; customized colors survive wallpaper replacement.

s opens Save and use confirmation, defaulting to Back to editor. Confirm to save once and apply; Esc/q cancels the draft without changing saved Intent or History. Declining confirmation keeps the draft. The sample is approximate, not live Ghostty reload.

Good to know

Save, Activation and reload are distinct. A failed apply can leave a saved Profile; a failed reload does not undo an Activation. Publication uncertainty requires inspection before retrying.

Delete safely#

Terminal
ghostty-wall delete night
ghostty-wall delete

Confirm the named target; Enter, EOF or n cancels by default. Welcome is protected. Deleting an active Profile commits existing Welcome before removal; a failed fallback preserves the target. An older installation without Welcome fails safely rather than inventing a fallback. Inactive deletion does not change Ghostty.

Only proven-exclusive owned images are eligible for cleanup. The original image, shared or ambiguous files, Sources, History and replay assets remain. Deleting the last personal Profile leaves Welcome available. After History replay there is no active Profile hint; apply a Profile before deleting.

Copy, rename and inspect#

Terminal
ghostty-wall duplicate night night-copy
ghostty-wall rename night-copy evening
ghostty-wall list
ghostty-wall preview evening
ghostty-wall history

Rename is limited to inactive, non-Welcome Profiles. Preview and History are read-only. For direct image import, use ghostty-wall new evening /path/to/image.png; append --apply only when you want immediate activation.

Existing Profiles and upgrades#

New owned-image Profiles use schema version 2, with image ownership and optional generation metadata. Existing version 1 Profiles remain readable and are not migrated just by browsing. Customizing version 1 generated colors saves version 2 Intent. Back up the entire Managed Root before downgrading; older binaries may not read new Intent or generated-color provenance.

Advanced: configuration files#

On Linux, your managed root is ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/ghostty/ghostty-wall. On macOS, it is ~/Library/Application Support/com.mitchellh.ghostty/ghostty-wall.

TOML remains an advanced interface, not a prerequisite for everyday customization.

Keep advanced changes in Intent

Do not edit current.ghostty. It is generated and can be replaced on the next apply.

1. Add a wallpaper source#

Add this section to config.toml. Keep the existing schema_version = 1 and your other sources.

config.toml
[sources.wallpapers]
kind = "local-directory"
path = "~/Pictures/wallpapers"

2. Write your profile#

Create profiles/night.toml. Its filename gives the profile its ID: night. Change the image path to a PNG or JPEG inside your source directory.

profiles/night.toml
schema_version = 1

[wallpaper]
mode = "source"
source = "wallpapers"
selection = "path"
path = "city/night.png"
fit = "cover"
position = "center"
opacity = 0.1

[colors]
mode = "generated"

[terminal]
font_size = 13.5
background_opacity = 0.94
cursor_style = "bar"

3. Preview, then apply#

Terminal
ghostty-wall plan night
ghostty-wall apply night

A few simple rules#

  • IDs use lowercase letters, digits, and internal hyphens, such as my-night.
  • Profiles live directly inside profiles/, without subdirectories.
  • Wallpaper, colors, and terminal sections are optional. Omitted settings remain unmanaged.
  • Generated colors require a wallpaper from a source.
